book.name: 1 Bhakolinso
book.title: Baluwa ja kutumbula jaka Paulo kwa Bhakolinso

content: Michangu ja kubhajangatila bhalongu bhahobhalela
Henu, kubhokana na michangu kwa ndandi ja kubhajangatila bhahuhu, nanamu mtendaje ngati monakalaghalakile kwa makanisa gha ku Galatia.
Kila Jumapili kila jumu winu na abhekaje akiba ja mbija kwaki kubhokana na kipatu chaki, nahuli ngakwikubha na ndandi ja kubhongana michangu heji chikahi panihikaje.
Chikahi panihika kwinu, ananabhatuma bhala bhamwahaghulaje pachilanda jinu bhapelakaje baluwa na nhupu hinu ku Yelusalemu.
Ngati anakwipalika na nepani nyendaje, bhela bhandu bhanihabha anabhajendaje papamu na nepani.
Mipangu jaka Paulo
Nambu ananhika kwinu chikahi ananyomwi kupetala ku Makedonia, kwa ndandi nhobhalela kupetela ku Makedonia.
Pangi nitama kwinu kwa chikahi, pangi chikahi chokapi cha imbepu, nahuli muweza kunyangatila kujenda mu mwanja wangu pokapi panijendaje.
Kwa ndandi ngachembala kumbona mabhanganya sajenu na kupeta pela, maghambu nhobhalela kutama kwinu kwa chikahi, ngati Bambo anaapalike.
Nambu anandama pani pa Efeso mbaka lichobha la Uwangalalu wa Pentekoste.
Kwa ndandi Bambo anhoghulili ndyangu wa kuhenga lihengu likolongwa, hata ngati kubhili na bhandu bhamaheli bhabhambenga.
Nambu, Timoseo anahikike, ndingalyaje impalika atama kwinu panga na choghohi, kwa ndandi najombi ahenga lihengu laka Bambo bhelabhela ngati monhenge nepani.

Bhela mundu jokapi ngaambona kubha nga chindu, nambu munjangatyaje ajendalya na mwanja waki kwa lukwale, nahuli aweza kukelabhuka kwangu, kwa ndandi nundendalela papamu na bhalongu bhitu bhahobhalela.
Nambu kwa malobhi ghaka ndongu witu Apolo, nakunjopiki namaa ahika kwinu papamu na bhalongu bhangi, nambu ngacheapala kuhika konihoku sajenu, nambu anaahika konihoku chikahi paanapata mbekenyu.
Malobhi gha kujomulela
Mtamaje mihu, na njemaje lukwale mu uhobhalelu, mbya na ukangamalu na mwembi na makile.
Ntendaje mambu ghinu ghokapi kwa upalu.

Bhalongu bhangu, mummanyi Stefana papamu na bhandu bha munyumba jaki, bhombi nde bhandu bha kutumbula nakanopi kujopalela uhobhalelu wa Kikristo ku Akaya, na bhalibhohiki kubhatumakila bhahuhu. Nunjopa mwanganya mwabhalongu bhangu,
muujengalya ulonguweku wa bhandu ngati bhanihabha, na ulonguweku waka kila mundu joahenga lihengu na kutumika papamu nabhu.
Nanatu nakahekalili pabhakahikike Stefana, Fotunato na Akaiko, maghambu bhanganya bhanihabha bhambekihi ghala ghanakepakiwi kuhuma kwinu.
Kwa ndandi bhajipeki chiheku roho jangu na roho hinu bhelabhela. Bhela ipalika namaa kubhakomboka bhandu ngati bhanihabha.
Makanisa ghokapi gha ku Asia ghundamukila. Akila na Pulisila bhundamukila namaa muka Bambo, papamu na likanisa lokapi lelihimangana kujojabhela munyumba jabhu.
Bhalongu bhokapi bhundamukila. Ndamukanyaje mabheti kwa mabheti kwa kulangiha nginyulila ja upalu waka Kristo.
Nepani nde Paulo nenembiki ulamukilu ghoni kwa chiwoku changu namwete.
Mundu jokapi jwangakumpala Bambo Yesu Kristo, na apata masolu. Malanasa, ndandi jaki, Bambo witu ahika!
Chihomu chaka Bambo witu Yesu Kristo chibya papamu na mwehapa.
Upalu wangu na ubya papamu na mwehapa mabhokapi muka Kristo Yesu. Amina.
